incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Inference capacity degraded on redwood-infer-prod-dedicated-3. Error rate spike + OOMs detected. Paging oncall Lee (channel: #incidents).
Lee (oncall): seeing elevated 5xx and some worker OOMs. scaling down batch_size and restarting pool now.
Anya (SRE): noted. do we have a quick mitigation plan if restarts don't hold? can we shift traffic to preemptible fallback cluster?
Lee (oncall): yes can route to redwood-infer-fallback-1, but throughput lower. doing `kubectl -n infer scale deployment/infer-workers --replicas=0` then back to desired to flush.
Sheila (eng): recommend flushing KV caches as well, there was a bad patch yesterday that increased memory usage on long context requests.
Tom (product): customer-facing note: we have a few enterprise customers on Dedicated 3, need impact estimate asap. Maya can you start triage with CS?
Maya (CS): on it. reaching out to impacted customers to ask if they saw latency/errors. will report back with customer list.
Lee (oncall): restart done, pods coming up. memory pressure dropping but slow. routing ~40% to fallback to stabilize.
Anya (SRE): monitoring shows error rate falling from 5% -> 0.8% over last 7m. latency tail still elevated ~120ms above normal.
incident-bot: MITIGATION NOTE: autoscale event temporarily disabled for pool redwood-infer-prod-dedicated-3 during investigation by oncall.
Sheila (eng): rolling back yesterday's KV retention bump is ready. suggest canary it to one node.
Lee (oncall): canary deployed to worker-7, no regressions so far.
Tom (product): preliminary customer impact: 3 enterprise customers experienced degraded QPS and sporadic 5xx for ~18m. Maya, please add notes to incident tracker.
Maya (CS): added notes and customer replies. two customers saw increased latency, one reported request failures.
Anya (SRE): proposed immediate actions: 1) revert KV retention change (Sheila) 2) add memory guardrails on worker pods (Lee) 3) postmortem + RCA (owner: Sheila).
Sheila (eng): I will own the RCA writeup. plan: draft by EOD tomorrow, peer review after that. will include timeline, config diffs, and memory profiles.
Lee (oncall): handoff: I'm handing bridge to Anya for overnight monitoring. Anya, I added runbook steps I used into the incident channel thread.
Anya (SRE): taking bridge. noted runbook. will escalate if memory > 85% again.
Tom (product): scheduling post-incident review: propose 60m on Thursday 10:00 PT. goal: review timeline, impact, action items, and sign-off. who can attend?
Sheila (eng): I can. will bring RCA draft.
Maya (CS): I'll join for customer impact summary.
Lee (oncall): I'll join the review for mitigation notes.
Anya (SRE): I'll join for ops remediation items.
Tom (product): ok scheduled: Thursday 10:00 PT — invite sent. action items captured below.
--- ACTION ITEMS ---
- Sheila: Draft RCA (timeline, contributing factors, memory graphs, revert justification). due: EOD +1 day (owner: Sheila) :memo:
- Lee: Add memory guardrails to helm chart and create automated alert for >75% memory on pool. due: 3 business days (owner: Lee) :wrench:
- Anya: Run overnight soak test on fallback routing and confirm autoscale re-enable conditions. due: tomorrow EOD (owner: Anya) :white_check_mark:
- Maya: Consolidate customer impact notes and send post-incident customer comms draft for review. due: tomorrow noon (owner: Maya) :email:
- Tom: Coordinate postmortem and sign-off, confirm reviewers and legal notification if needed. due: before review meeting (owner: Tom) :calendar:
--- END ACTION ITEMS ---
Sheila (eng): reviewer list: Anya, Lee, and Tom. I'll ping for PR review once draft is in docs repo.
Anya (SRE): will review RCA, focus on ops mitigations and alert tuning.
Lee (oncall): will test guardrail changes in staging before rollout.
Maya (CS): customer comms draft will aim to be non-technical and include timeline + apology + mitigation summary.
Tom (product): sign-off plan: postmortem approved by engineering leads + SRE + CS, legal looped if customer requests or data exposure.
Sheila (eng): estimated root cause: memory retention change + larger-than-expected long-context requests. will validate with heap profiles and perf captures.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated - service stabilized; postmortem required. incident closed on bridge handover.
Lee (oncall): thanks team. handing off final notes to Anya and Sheila for RCA.
Anya (SRE): noted. I'll keep monitoring overnight and update thread tomorrow morning with metrics. :eyes:
Maya (CS): I'll draft customer note and share for review in this thread.
Tom (product): thanks all. good mitigation work. we'll aim for RCA sign-off within 5 business days. :thumbsup:
